Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target tid for CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Require both canonical_smiles and pubmed_id or doi to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
